description: Codex-native ChinamaX lifecycle and Bridge hooks. Windows handlers explicitly enter Git Bash so the shared Runtime shell contract remains unchanged.

hooks.commandWindows: bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/session_start_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/session_end_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/stop_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/user_prompt_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/bridge_contract_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/codex_pretool_hook"'
bash -lc 'root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then root="$(cygpath -u -- "$root")"; fi; exec "$root/scripts/bridge_contract_hook"'
